title: •Crossfire
caption: •Crossfire (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your AT-STs are immune to attrition < 3 (or their immunity to attrition is +2). Once per game, may lose 1 Force to ▲ an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand The Empire). May place this Effect out of play to add one battle destiny. {alter}
lore: Scout walker pilots are trained to set up a deadly heavy fire zone. This tactic can be disrupted by enemy weapons fire.
